SELECT p.* FROM product p
AND p.status = #{status}
AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.detail LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY p.sales DESC, p.created_at DESC
SELECT p.*, c.category_name as category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId}
